ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:4 ratio of high-intensity (white/grey) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity mottle-blobs are primarily localized at the distal tips of both lobes, with sparse, smaller clusters scattered along the lower margins.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 60 degrees and a significant penetration depth into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge contour characterized by high-amplitude jagged excisions on the left lobe and frequent, lower-amplitude serrations across the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature sweeping upward toward sharp distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Several small, circular high-contrast white pixel clusters visible on the medial and distal surface of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of fine, unaligned light-colored linear pixel marks oriented vertically and diagonally across the dark pigmentation of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular jagged missing segments on the trailing edge of the left lobe indicating previous physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Partial occlusion of the lower central ventral surface due to high-intensity pixel noise from water spray and turbulence.
